name: Sierro (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sierro (a castle on red, an eagle on white and waves).
history: Sierro adopted its arms and flag officially on 24 October 2003; the flag is a rectangular cloth one and a half times longer than wide, divided vertically into three equal stripes, blue, white and blue.

features.role: Sierro arms — castle, eagle and waves
